sections.label: Upload Settings
sections.help: Which systems DCS-DTC types into the jet when you press Upload. Routes, smart weapons, radios, misc and displays are uploaded on the UFC/MPDs of the seat you occupy.

sections.label: Capture Settings
sections.help: Where points captured from the DCS F10 map (Ctrl+Shift+D) are placed in the route. App-side only, never uploaded.

sections.label: Route A
sections.help: Steerpoints of route A (UFC points n.A). One route set is shared by both seats.

sections.label: Route B
sections.help: Steerpoints of route B (UFC points n.B).

sections.label: Route C
sections.help: Steerpoints of route C (UFC points n.C).

sections.label: Radios
sections.help: Radio 1 = MAIN (UHF only, 20 presets), Radio 2 = AUX (FM/VHF/UHF, 40 presets). Typed on the occupied seat's UFC.

sections.label: Displays
sections.help: MPD/MPCD PROG lists: up to three formats per display, each optionally tied to a master mode. Only programmed if the display has no PROG entries yet. AfterLoadFromJson re-creates a missing Displays.WSO but not Displays.Pilot.

sections.label: Smart Weapons
sections.help: JDAM/GBU mission coordinates per station (SMART > EDIT MSN). One target per station; only Settings[0] is used.

sections.label: Misc
sections.help: Bingo, bullseye, CARA low-altitude warning, TACAN, ILS and TGP laser code. Each item is only uploaded when its *ToBeUpdated flag is set.

fields.label: Aircraft code
fields.help: Always "F15E". The loader picks the C# type from this value.

fields.label: Format version
fields.help: Always 2. Missing/1 together with a missing Upload triggers the V1 converter.

fields.label: Kneeboard notes
fields.help: Free text shown in the in-game kneeboard dialog (sent when Upload.Kneeboard is set). Not a system: not copied by Load from file.

fields.label: Displays upload seats
fields.help: AutoSelect programs only the occupied seat's displays; PilotAndWSO jumps seats to program both cockpits.

fields.label: Kneeboard
fields.help: Send preset name/summary and KneeboardNotes to the in-game kneeboard dialog after upload.

fields.label: Nav points placement

options.label: Add to end of first gap

fields.help: Placement of captured non-target points in the chosen route. Route-related app setting; keep default when the route is exported from the dashboard.

fields.label: Target points placement
fields.help: Placement of captured target points. The UI only offers Add to end of list and Add to range.

fields.label: Nav range start
fields.help: First sequence used when NavPointsMode = Add to range.

fields.label: Target range start
fields.help: First sequence used when TgtPointsMode = Add to range.

fields.label: Route A steerpoints
fields.help: Filled from the planned route. Each route waypoint becomes UFC point "<Sequence>A" (Sequence 1..99, unique, list kept sorted by Sequence; number consecutively from 1). Use route A for the main flight plan, B/C for alternates or a split (e.g. ingress/egress). Target = true also creates the target point "<Sequence>.A" ("." = DOT) and the coordinates are entered there. Uploaded: Sequence, Target, Latitude, Longitude, Elevation, MEA. Not uploaded: Name (kneeboard/list only, no length limit enforced) and TimeOverSteerpoint. The first point of the first uploaded route becomes the active steerpoint.

fields.label: Sequence
fields.help: Steerpoint number within route A. Unique per route.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Required (non-empty) by the editor; app default "STPT <seq>". Not uploaded, shown on kneeboard.

fields.label: Latitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths, e.g. "N 42°10.630’" (U+00B0, U+2019).

fields.label: Longitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths, 3-digit degrees, e.g. "E 042°28.840’".

fields.label: Elevation
fields.help: Feet MSL (ground elevation of the point).

fields.label: TOS
fields.help: HH:MM:SS or null. Stored/kneeboard only, not uploaded to the jet.

fields.label: Target point
fields.help: Set for route target waypoints: uploads to target point n. instead of plain steerpoint n.

fields.label: MEA
fields.help: Minimum enroute altitude for the leg, uploaded (PB08). Dashboard may derive it from planned altitude/terrain; 0 if unknown.

fields.label: MAIN presets
fields.help: Preset channels 1..20, ordered by Number; null or [] when none.

fields.label: Preset #
fields.help: Preset channel number (unique). Files with a preset Number 0 get every number +1 on load.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Label only (not uploaded).

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: UHF 225.000-399.975 MHz; exactly 3 decimals, 5 kHz steps. No 2-decimal fix-up on the F-15E.

fields.label: Manual frequency
fields.help: UHF 225.000-399.975 MHz. Typed whenever non-empty.

fields.label: Selected preset
fields.help: Preset number as a string "1".."20", or "G" (UHF guard).

fields.label: Radio left on
fields.help: Which of manual frequency or preset the radio is left on. 0 = unset (a fresh preset).

fields.label: AUX presets
fields.help: Preset channels 1..40, ordered by Number; null or [] when none.

fields.label: Preset #
fields.help: Preset channel number (unique). Files with a preset Number 0 get every number +1 on load.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Label only (not uploaded).

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: FM 30.000-87.975, VHF 108.000-173.975, UHF 225.000-399.975 MHz; exactly 3 decimals, 5 kHz steps. No 2-decimal fix-up on the F-15E.

fields.label: Manual frequency

fields.help: Preset number as a string "1".."40", "G" (UHF guard) or "GV" (VHF guard).

fields.label: Radio left on
fields.help: Which of manual frequency or preset the radio is left on. 0 = unset (a fresh preset).

fields.label: Stations
fields.help: Dictionary keyed by station name (exact keys listed; other keys ignored). Not route-managed by default: a station target needs a station choice. The dashboard may offer "assign target waypoint to station", copying that route target point's Latitude/Longitude/Elevation into Settings[0].

fields.label: Station
fields.help: Same as the dictionary key.

fields.label: Targets
fields.help: null or [] = station not programmed. Only the first entry is used.

fields.label: Elevation
fields.help: Target elevation, feet MSL.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Tooltip/kneeboard only, not uploaded.

fields.label: Bingo
fields.help: Rounded down to 100 lb.

fields.label: Bullseye
fields.help: ONE string holding lat and lon separated by a space: "N 42°10.630’ E 042°28.840’" (DDM thousandths).

fields.label: CARA low alt warning
fields.help: Rounded to the nearest 10 ft by the UI.

fields.label: Update TACAN
fields.help: Also turns the TACAN on if it is off.

fields.label: ILS frequency
fields.help: JSON number (C# decimal), 2 decimals. UI regex ^1[0-1][8|9|0|1]\.[1|3|5|7|9]?[0|5]?$ (odd tenths, .x0/.x5), range 108.10-111.95.

fields.label: TGP laser code
fields.help: 4 digits: first 1-2, others 1-8. The F-15E has no LST code.
